Both values come from the "RL Model Updates" heatmap in Figure 2 on page 4.

- **Math–Science cosine similarity:** −3.92e-04 (about −0.000392). This is in the off-diagonal cells where Math and Science meet. (p. 4)
- **Logic update norm:** ‖ΔW‖ = 8.7e-02 (about 0.087). This is the diagonal Logic cell. (p. 4)

According to the figure caption, the off-diagonal cells show cosine similarities and the diagonal cells show the L₂ norm of each task's update. RL updates have near-zero similarity, which the authors read as "orthogonal and task-specific parameter adjustments." (p. 4)
